props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close after a pick. Defaults to `!multiple`.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Checkbox selection of leaves; a branch stands for all of its leaves.

props.name: selectableBranches
props.description: Single mode only: allow picking a branch itself instead of expanding it.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description:
Whether to automatically set focus on the first focusable
content within the popover when opened.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Whether to close the popover when the escape key is pressed.

props.name: closeOnInteractOutside
props.description: Whether to close the popover when the user clicks outside of the popover.

props.name: defaultTriggerValue
props.description:
The initial trigger value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the trigger value.

props.name: finalFocusEl
props.description: Element to receive focus when the popover is closed.

props.name: hideMode
props.description:
How to hide content when mounted but not present.
- `'display-none'`: HTML `hidden` attribute. Effects stay alive.
- `'activity'`: React 19 `<Activity mode="hidden">`. Effects pause. Requires React 19+.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the popover. Useful for composition.

props.name: immediate
props.description: Whether to synchronize the present change immediately or defer it to the next frame

props.name: initialFocusEl
props.description: The element to focus on when the popover is opened.

props.name: lazyMount
props.description: Whether to enable lazy mounting

props.name: modal
props.description:
Whether the popover should be modal. When set to `true`:
- interaction with outside elements will be disabled
- only popover content will be visible to screen readers
- scrolling is blocked
- focus is trapped within the popover

props.name: onEnterComplete
props.description: Function called when the animation ends in the open state

props.name: onEscapeKeyDown
props.description: Function called when the escape key is pressed

props.name: onExitComplete
props.description: Function called when the animation ends in the closed state

props.name: onFocusOutside
props.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

props.name: onInteractOutside
props.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

props.name: onPointerDownOutside
props.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

props.name: onRequestDismiss
props.description: Function called when this layer is closed due to a parent layer being closed

props.name: onTriggerValueChange
props.description: Function called when the trigger value changes.

props.name: persistentElements
props.description:
Returns the persistent elements that:
- should not have pointer-events disabled
- should not trigger the dismiss event

props.name: portalled
props.description:
Whether the popover is portalled. This will proxy the tabbing behavior regardless of the DOM position
of the popover content.

props.name: positioning
props.description: The user provided options used to position the popover content

props.name: present
props.description: Whether the node is present (controlled by the user)

props.name: restoreFocus
props.description: Whether to restore focus to the element that had focus before the popover was opened.

props.name: skipAnimationOnMount
props.description: Whether to allow the initial presence animation.

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: triggerValue
props.description: The controlled trigger value

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description: Whether to unmount on exit.

docs:
## Tree select and cascader
Both live on Ark's `TreeCollection` (`createTreeCollection`, re-exported) and a Popover, and own
only the open state, the search query, and the value (`value`/`defaultValue`/`onValueChange`,
always a `string[]`); the trigger is a focusable `div[role=combobox]` via `PopoverTrigger asChild`
so chips and clear buttons inside it stay real buttons. Both use `src/lib/controllable.ts`
`useControllable(controlled, default, onChange)` (the shared controllable-state hook; prefer it
over local copies).
`src/components/ui/tree-select.tsx`: `TreeSelect { collection, multiple, selectableBranches,
closeOnSelect, expandedValue…, open…, disabled, readOnly, invalid }` > `TreeSelectTrigger`
(`size`, `variant="unstyled"`; Enter/Space/ArrowDown open, Backspace removes the last chip) >
`TreeSelectValue` (labels joined, render-prop child gets the nodes) or `TreeSelectChips` >
`TreeSelectChip node=` (remove button), `TreeSelectClearTrigger`, `TreeSelectIndicator`;
`TreeSelectContent` (same width as the trigger) > `TreeSelectSearch` (filters the collection with
ancestors kept and auto-expands matches; ArrowDown moves into the tree), `TreeSelectTree`
(renders the toolkit `TreeView` parts recursively through `TreeSelectNode`; render-prop child
customises the row label), `TreeSelectEmpty`; `TreeSelectHiddenInput name=`. Multiple mode is
Ark checkbox semantics: `value` holds leaf values only, a branch toggles all its leaves, and
`collapseValues(collection, value)` (used by the value/chips) shows a fully selected branch as one
chip. Single mode ignores branch picks unless `selectableBranches`. `useTreeSelect()` exposes it all.
`src/components/ui/cascader.tsx`: `Cascader { collection, changeOnSelect, expandTrigger:
click|hover, open…, disabled, readOnly, invalid }` > `CascaderTrigger` > `CascaderValue`
(the path as "A / B / C", `separator`, render-prop child gets the path nodes), `CascaderClearTrigger`,
`CascaderIndicator`; `CascaderContent` (owns the keyboard: ↑/↓ within a column, → opens a branch,
← back to the parent, Home/End, Enter/Space activates) > `CascaderSearch` (matches every level,
flat results replace the columns), `CascaderColumns` (`role="tree"`, `aria-activedescendant`;
column `i + 1` lists the children of `expandedPath[i]`; render-prop child customises items) >
`CascaderColumn depth=` > `CascaderItem node=` (`data-branch/expanded/selected/highlighted/disabled`)
> `CascaderItemText` + `CascaderItemIndicator` (chevron on branches, check on the selected leaf),
`CascaderSearchResults` > `CascaderSearchResult path=`, `CascaderEmpty`, `CascaderHiddenInput`.
Picking a leaf closes; a branch opens the next column and, with `changeOnSelect`, is itself the
value. Opening starts from the current value's path. `useCascader()` exposes it all.
`src/demo/pickers/` is the reference (`/access`, "Roles & access"): folder picker with branches selectable and
icons, people/teams multi-select with chips, hover-expanding location cascader with search, and a
change-on-select category cascader.
